decision_rationale: The paper presents Longevity-LLM v0.1 as a trained multimodal model, not just an application wrapper, and explicitly reports proteomic profile generation. It also frames the work as building foundation models and describes broad training across 38 tasks and four modalities.
evidence_snippet: “proteomic profile generation”; “an initiative dedicated to building foundation models for drug discovery and aging research”; “766,640 examples ... spanning 38 tasks across four primary data modalities”
